--- create_property_graph_named_schema.sql
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH sch.G NODE TABLES (People)

--- AST
&ast.CreatePropertyGraph{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 22,
        NameEnd: 25,
        Name:    "sch",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 26,
        NameEnd: 27,
        Name:    "G",
      },
    },
  },
  Content: &ast.PropertyGraphContent{
    NodeTables: &ast.PropertyGraphNodeTables{
      Node:   28,
      Tables: &ast.PropertyGraphElementList{
        Lparen:   40,
        Rparen:   47,
        Elements: []*ast.PropertyGraphElement{
          &ast.PropertyGraphElement{
            Name: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 41,
              NameEnd: 47,
              Name:    "People",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH sch.G NODE TABLES (People)
